$comment: The single source of truth for what the SMS filter must accept and reject.
Two implementations read this file: the Java one in apps/api (SmsFilterVectorTest)
and the TypeScript one in apps/mobile (sms-filter.test.ts). Neither owns it. If
somebody tightens a rule on one side and forgets the other, the forgotten side
fails here rather than in production, which is the entire point of keeping the
examples in a language-neutral file instead of duplicating them as test code.
Add a case whenever a real message is mishandled. The bodies below are written
in the house style of Indian bank alerts because that is what the app will meet
first, but nothing in the filter is India-specific.
